svg.title: Layer-1 sub-goal chains
svg.desc: Gold TidyHouse decompositions next to every DeepSeek decomposition, aligned by transfer.
svg.text: Layer-1 sub-goal chains: gold references and DeepSeek decompositions
TidyHouse, five transfers · each column is one decomposition, top to bottom in execution order · a coarse sub-goal spans the four fine sub-goals of the same transfer
the goal text names no object–receptacle pairing: the static requests list the receptacles in transfer order and the model pairs by position;
the scenario runs list them alphabetically and the model guesses (9 of 10 destinations differ from the goal facts)
initial proposal of the object_dropped run
initial proposal of the pick_exhausted run
box = one sub-goal (Layer 1) · fill: orange at(object, receptacle), purple holding(object), blue reachable(x) · n = skill nodes in the sub-goal's subgraph when not one
dashed red = a predicate that is not among the gold goal facts (at) or the gold fine predicates (reachable, holding); the sub-goal ids are the proposer's own
